ruleset.name: nitpicker
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD categories for main and test sources.

rule.message: Field {0} has the same name as a method. Rename one of them; a method named exactly like its field with at most one parameter (an accessor, a fluent setter or builder step) is allowed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static' and pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId [some $method in ../../..[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody]/MethodDeclaration satisfies lower-case(@Name) = lower-case($method/@Name) and not(@Name = $method/@Name and $method/FormalParameters[@Size < 2])]

rule.message: Use a named constant instead of this literal in the condition (-1, 0, 1 and 2 are allowed).

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[self::StringLiteral or self::CharLiteral]

rule.message: Assign first, then use the variable. An assignment in a while condition is allowed.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] [ModifierList/Annotation or (@Name = 'main' and @Static = true() and FormalParameters/@Size = 1 and FormalParameters/FormalParameter[1]/*[2][self::ArrayType or ../@Varargs = true()])] | ./ancestor-or-self::FormalParameter[ModifierList/Annotation] | ./ancestor::MethodDeclaration[@Overridden = true()]

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MappedSuperclass')]

rule.message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.debug("user '{'}", user)) and compute nothing in the arguments; guard the call with isDebugEnabled() only when an argument must be computed.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]] [not(ArgumentList/*[position() > 1][not( self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression or self::StringLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::CharLiteral or self::NullLiteral or (self::MethodCall[ArgumentList[@Size = 0]] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression]]))])]

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .//AssignmentExpression/ArrayAccess/*[2]/descendant-or-self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '-'] /*[2]/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[not(parent::FieldAccess)]

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[count(../../*) > 1 or ../../..[self::ForStatement][not(ForUpdate/StatementExpressionList/UnaryExpression[@Operator = '++'])]]

rule.message: Return the condition instead of branching to true or false: if (c) return true; return false; is return c;, and if (c) return true; return x; is return c || x;.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[not(ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::LambdaExpression][1][self::MethodDeclaration]/PrimitiveType[@Kind = 'boolean'])]

rule.message: Drop the comparison with a boolean literal: x == true and x != false are x, x == false and x != true are !x.
Write the boolean ternary with a logical operator: c ? true : x is c || x, c ? false : x is !c && x, c ? x : true is !c || x, c ? x : false is c && x.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[*[position() > 1][not(self::BooleanLiteral)][not(pmd-java:typeIs('boolean') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean'))]]

rule.message: Drop the null check: x instanceof Foo is already false when x is null.
Merge the nested if into its parent with &&: if (a) '{' if (b) '{' ... } } is if (a && b) '{' ... }.
Use the opposite operator instead of negating the comparison: !(a == b) is a != b, !(a < b) is a >= b.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[@Operator = ('<', '>', '<=', '>=')] [*[pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Double') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Float')]]

rule.message: Drop the negation and swap the branches: if (!c) A else B is if (c) B else A, and !c ? a : b is c ? b : a.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: .[not(*[1][self::UnaryExpression][@Operator = '!']) or self::ConditionalExpression[BooleanLiteral] or self::IfStatement[*[position() > 1]/(self::ReturnStatement | self::Block[count(*) = 1]/ReturnStatement)/BooleanLiteral]]

rule.name: CleanupSkippedOnFailure
rule.message: This release can throw, so the release or reset after it in the same block never runs and a connection stays open or the state is not reset. Release each resource in try-with-resources or try/finally (or catch each release and rethrow the first failure after the rest ran), or hold them in one AutoCloseable list closed with addSuppressed. An exception fits only when a failed release should abort the remaining ones.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $releases := ('close', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'shutdownNow', 'stop', 'terminate', 'unsubscribe', 'dispose', 'quit'), $throwing := ('close', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'stop', 'terminate', 'unsubscribe', 'dispose', 'quit'), $cleanup := ('close', 'dispose', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'stop', 'teardown', 'tearDown', 'disconnect', 'end', 'cleanup'), $hooks := ('org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach', 'org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll', 'org.junit.After', 'org.junit.AfterClass', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterMethod', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterClass', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterSuite', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterTest', 'javax.annotation.PreDestroy', 'jakarta.annotation.PreDestroy'), $releasing := function($statement) { exists($statement/MethodCall[@MethodName = $releases]) } return //MethodDeclaration[@Name = $cleanup or ModifierList/Annotation[some $hook in $hooks satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($hook)]] /Block/ExpressionStatement[MethodCall[@MethodName = $throwing]] [not(MethodCall[*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService')]])] [empty(preceding-sibling::ExpressionStatement[$releasing(.)])] [exists(following-sibling::ExpressionStatement[$releasing(.) or AssignmentExpression[*[2][self::NullLiteral]] or MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear']])]

rule.name: GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode
rule.message: Remove the annotation from hand-written code: JaCoCo skips code carrying an annotation whose name contains Generated, and PIT skips @Generated, so this is not measured. Put the JPA @GeneratedValue on the field.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //(ClassDeclaration | RecordDeclaration | EnumDeclaration | MethodDeclaration | ConstructorDeclaration | CompactConstructorDeclaration) /ModifierList/Annotation[contains(@SimpleName, 'Generated')]

rule.name: InconsistentFieldLocking
rule.message: This write of a field holds no lock, while another write of the same field in the class holds one: a thread that writes here races with the locked writer, so an update is lost or another thread sees a stale value. Hold the lock the locked write holds for every write of the field (synchronized on the same monitor, or lock() and unlock() of the same Lock), or make the field an atomic or concurrent type (AtomicLong, LongAdder, ConcurrentHashMap). Constructors, initializers, a single write of a volatile field, a write in a lambda and a method the class calls while it holds a lock are not reported.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: LockOrderInversion
rule.message: This nesting takes two locks of the class in the opposite order to another nesting of the class: two threads that run both can each hold one lock and wait forever for the other, a deadlock that no test reliably shows. Take nested locks in one order everywhere in the class (if any path takes a and then b, no path takes b and then a), or guard the state with one lock. Only locks held in fields of the class, this, Type.class and Type.FIELD are compared; a lock passed in, held in a local or taken in a called method is not followed.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: LogExceptionFirst
rule.message: Pass the exception first (log.errorf(e, "Cannot read %s", path)), or e.getMessage() when only the text is wanted. After the format, JBoss Logging never logs its stack trace.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: LogFormatArguments
rule.message: Pass one argument per placeholder, in the method''s own syntax: %s for printf methods (JBoss Logging infof, Log4j 2 printf and formatter loggers), '{'0} for MessageFormat methods (JBoss Logging infov, java.util.logging log), with '''' for an apostrophe there. Keep the format a constant. Otherwise values are dropped or the call throws.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: LogStringConcatenation
rule.message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]] /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1]) [(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'] and not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())) or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted')]]

rule.name: MutableStaticCollection
rule.message: Do not mutate a static collection or expose a mutable one. Build it once as an immutable List.of, Map.of or Map.copyOf, or keep the state in an instance.
rule.description: A static final collection that is public or changed after class loading is global mutable state.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final'] [VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private' and VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListSet') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.BlockingDeque')])] [let $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public' or ancestor::ClassBody[1]//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('add', 'addAll', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'remove', 'clear', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'offer', 'push', 'poll', 'pop', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'removeIf', 'replaceAll', 'sort')] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name = $name] [ancestor::MethodDeclaration or ancestor::ConstructorDeclaration]]

rule.name: MutationIgnoreMarker
rule.message: Remove the annotation and kill the mutants with a test: PIT does not mutate code annotated @DoNotMutate or @CoverageIgnore.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //Annotation[@SimpleName = ('DoNotMutate', 'CoverageIgnore')]

rule.name: NegatedOperands
rule.message: Negate once: !a && !b is !(a || b), and !a || !b is !(a && b).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')] [let $op := @Operator, $top := ., $chain := ($top, $top//InfixExpression[@Operator = $op] [every $between in (ancestor::* intersect $top/descendant::*) satisfies $between[self::InfixExpression][@Operator = $op]]), $operands := $chain/*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])] return not(parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op]) and (every $operand in $operands satisfies $operand[self::UnaryExpression][@Operator = '!'])]

rule.name: SwallowedInterrupt
rule.message: This catch of InterruptedException can complete without rethrowing it or restoring the interrupt, so the interrupt status of the thread is lost and work that was asked to stop keeps running.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: TaskOutlivesTryResource
rule.message: The task started by {0}() reads a resource of its try-with-resources, but nothing waits for it after it starts, unconditionally, before the block ends, so the resource is closed while the task can still run. Wait inside the block: get() or join() on the future, awaitTermination or close on the executor, take() or a timed poll() on its CompletionService, await() on a latch or barrier, or declare the executor as a later resource of the same try so it closes first and waits. Or open the resource inside the task.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall [@MethodName = ('submit', 'execute', 'schedule', 'scheduleAtFixedRate', 'scheduleWithFixedDelay') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Executor') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionService') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Timer')] or @MethodName = ('supplyAsync', 'runAsync') and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture')] or @MethodName = ('thenApplyAsync', 'thenAcceptAsync', 'thenRunAsync', 'thenComposeAsync', 'whenCompleteAsync', 'handleAsync') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.CompletionStage')] or @MethodName = 'startVirtualThread' and *[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')] or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')] or @MethodName = 'start' and *[1][self::MethodCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread.Builder')]] [let $s := . return some $block in ancestor::Block[parent::TryStatement[ResourceList]] satisfies (let $receiver := *[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name, $arguments := (ArgumentList/*, *[1][self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/*), $resources := $block/parent::TryStatement/ResourceList/Resource, $captured := $resources[ let $name := (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name) return exists($arguments[self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodReference or self::ConstructorCall[AnonymousClassDeclaration]] //VariableAccess[@Name = $name]) or exists($arguments[self::ConstructorCall]/ArgumentList/VariableAccess[@Name = $name])], $chain := $s/ancestor-or-self::MethodCall[ every $step in ($s/ancestor::* intersect ./descendant::*) satisfies $step/self::MethodCall], $top := $chain[1], $holder := ($top/parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $top/parent::AssignmentExpression[*[2] is $top]/*[1][self::VariableAccess]/@Name), $uses := $block//VariableAccess[@Name = $holder][. >> $s][not(parent::AssignmentExpression and . is ../*[1])], $waits := $block//MethodCall[. >> $s] [@MethodName = ('awaitTermination', 'close') and *[1][self::VariableAccess/@Name = $receiver] or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Phaser') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Semaphore')]] [every $region in ancestor::*[. >> $block] [self::CatchClause or self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration or (parent::IfStatement or parent::ConditionalExpression or parent::SwitchStatement or parent::SwitchExpression) and not(. is ../*[1]) or (parent::ForeachStatement or parent::ForStatement or parent::WhileStatement) and . is ../*[last()] or parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')] and . is ../*[2]] satisfies exists($region intersect $s/ancestor-or-self::*)] return exists($captured) and not(ancestor::*[self::LambdaExpression or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration][. >> $block]) and not($chain[@MethodName = ('get', 'join', 'getNow', 'resultNow', 'awaitTermination')]) and ($top/parent::ExpressionStatement or $top/parent::ReturnStatement or (exists($holder) and (every $use in $uses satisfies $use/parent::ReturnStatement))) and (some $resource in $captured satisfies empty($resource/following-sibling::Resource[ (LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, VariableAccess/@Name) = $receiver])) and empty($waits))]
